doc.summary: Bootstrap a fresh Garage deployment for QuantumVault.
doc.description: What this does: 1. Waits for the admin API to respond. 2. Connects the local node to the cluster (single-node layout). 3. Creates the quantumvault bucket. 4. Creates a scoped API key with read+write on that bucket only. 5. Emits the credentials for .env (S3_ACCESS_KEY / S3_SECRET_KEY).  Usage: docker compose up -d garage scripts/garage-init.sh  The script reads GARAGE_RPC_SECRET and GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN from the .env file (or the environment) so the admin API can be authenticated.
